# Generated by tools/build_equipment.py.
random_yearly_everyone_pulse = { on_actions = { ac_equipment_ai_pulse } }
ac_equipment_ai_pulse = {
	trigger = { has_trait = ac_cultivator is_ai = yes }
	effect = { random = { chance = 20 ac_ai_equipment_routine_effect = yes } }
}
# The world's strongest cultivators start with forged weapons in their materials.
on_game_start = { on_actions = { ac_equipment_seed } }
ac_equipment_seed = {
	effect = {
		every_living_character = {
			# Sect Masters and stronger (40+ Core dots); Aura Pressure is not yet counted at game start.
			limit = { has_trait = ac_cultivator ac_core_dots >= 40 }
			random_list = {
				1 = { ac_ai_forge_effect = { MATERIAL = jade } }
				1 = { ac_ai_forge_effect = { MATERIAL = beastbone } }
				1 = { ac_ai_forge_effect = { MATERIAL = snowsteel } }
				1 = { ac_ai_forge_effect = { MATERIAL = truegold } }
			}
		}
	}
}
